# Screenshots

Store feature, UI, issue, and generated audit screenshots here for use in PRs,
issues, and documentation.

The retired top-level `bugs/` directory is intentionally empty/absent. Keep raw
evidence in this folder and move narrative findings or active product decisions
to the central docs project PRD.

## Subdirectories

- `bugs/` - historical issue evidence from the retired top-level bug evidence
  folder.
- `header-audit/` - generated by `scripts/audit/header-audit.mjs`.

**Naming convention:** `<feature-or-context>-<nn>-<description>.<ext>`
Examples: `invoice-bug-01-editor-view.png`, `onboarding-03-welcome-screen.jpg`

Reference from issues/PRs using the `main` branch URL:
```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/main/.github/screenshots/<subdir>/<filename>
```
